description: Versioned, read-only inventory of one OpenMausBot bot's skills (PROJECT_BOOK §4.5 boundary 2). The snapshot is the SkillScope-side contract: it lists the skills the host claims the bot can load, so the adapter can compare the claim against the host's public config (config.json flags, library opt-out) and against the skill directories actually present on disk. It is never written by SkillScope, never sent to the host, and never trusted when its version is unknown: an unknown version means the whole inventory is unenumerated (INCOMPLETE). A per-bot list (assigned / imported / plugin) that is neither present in `skills` nor declared empty in `emptyLists` is missing, not empty — absence is ambiguous and must fail closed.

disabledPluginIds.description: Plugin ids switched off for this bot (turn/start disabledPluginIds). A listed plugin's skills are DISABLED, not ELIGIBLE. #5449 notes the host historically had no such switch at turn/start; the snapshot records the switch when the host provides one.

emptyLists.description: Per-bot lists the snapshot asserts are EMPTY (no skills of that kind). A list that is neither present in `skills` nor declared here is missing: the adapter reports SOURCE_NOT_ENUMERATED for its scope and the audit is INCOMPLETE. Absence is never read as empty.

loadableRoots.description: Absolute paths the host would load skills from (repo / user roots). Used to decide whether a closed imported skill's original folder is still active.

nativeDisabledNames.description: Native skill names switched off for this bot (name-based switch). A name switch hits every instance with that logical name, not just the native one.

skills.description: Per-bot skill inventory. One entry per skill folder the bot may load.

importState.description: IMPORTED only: whether the imported copy is switched on. A closed copy does not unload the original folder (#5449 item 7).

kind.description: Where the skill comes from. assigned/imported/plugin are per-bot lists; library is the shared every-bot library; user-claude is the machine's personal ~/.claude/skills; repo is a repo-root skill; native is a built-in host skill.

name.description: Skill name as the host reports it (folder name / manifest name).

originalPath.description: IMPORTED only: the original folder the import came from.

path.description: Path of the skill directory (fixture-relative in tests, absolute in production use). Points at ONE skill folder, not at a root of skill folders.

pluginId.description: PLUGIN only: the plugin that installed the skill. A plugin skill without a pluginId has no per-plugin disable path: disabledPluginIds can never cover it, so the adapter reports it UNKNOWN / INCOMPLETE instead of silently treating it as switchable.

version.description: Contract version. Any other value is an unknown snapshot version: the inventory cannot be trusted.

title: OpenMausBot per-bot skill inventory snapshot (v1)
